name: Agentic Coding
description: Claude Code writes, tests, and verifies code across multiple files and parallel subagents, going beyond autocomplete to build entire features from natural language.

name: Computer Use
description: Claude can open apps, navigate browsers, and run dev tools directly to complete tasks that don't yet have a dedicated integration.

name: Routines & Scheduling
description: Configurable automated tasks that run on a schedule, from an API call, or in response to an event — no manual trigger required.

name: Prompt Caching
description: Reduces cost and latency for repeated context by letting developers cache background knowledge and examples across API calls.

name: MCP Connector
description: Connects Claude to remote Model Context Protocol servers without writing custom client code, extending Claude's reach into external tools.

name: Reproducible Artifacts
description: Every scientific output includes the exact code, environment, and conversation that produced it, with a background reviewer flagging incorrect citations or untraceable numbers.

name: Design System Import
description: Claude Design imports components and brand styling from GitHub, design files, or local codebases so generated visuals match real production assets.

name: Adversarial Finding Verification
description: Claude Security challenges its own vulnerability findings before surfacing them, reducing false positives compared to rule-based scanners.

name: Enterprise Observability
description: OpenTelemetry export of session activity, token usage, and cost, plus a contribution metrics dashboard for engineering-wide adoption tracking.

name: SSO & SCIM Provisioning
description: Enterprise-grade identity integration (Okta, Azure AD, SAML 2.0) with automated user provisioning and role-based access control.

name: Memory Across Conversations
description: Claude remembers context from past conversations and can import memory when switching from another AI provider.

name: Plugin System
description: Bundles skills, connectors, and sub-agents into role-specific specialists (e.g. Brand Voice, Legal, Finance plugins) for Claude Cowork.
